The model is an amorphous, lumpy mass and completely fails to capture the building's iconic large-scale curving, sail-like metallic forms.
The distinct sculptural quality and major projections that define the building are entirely absent.
The outline is a noisy, blob-like shape that lacks the defined curves and sharp angles of the real building's footprint.
While the general shape is irregular, it fails to capture the specific forms of the major extensions visible in the satellite view.
The model's height is severely truncated, missing the tall, sail-like structures that define the building's vertical profile.
